tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Work done certificate: Bidder should have conducted minimum of 248 ABC Surgeries (75 percentage of the total estimated surgeries in a year) satisfactorily in any of the three financial years, i.e., 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 and should not have had any major registered complaints with respect to the violation of ABC rules-2023, section- 4(2) and there after the guilt proved. Bidders should submit work orders & work completion certificates as document for work experience to fulfill the criteria
Firm Registration Certificate: The bidder should submit valid Animal Welfare Board of India (AWBI) registration certificate

Annual financial turnover: The bidder should have achieved a minimum annual financial turnover of 5.50 Lakhs in any one of the last three financial years i.e 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 Bidder should submit audited balance sheets or annual turnover document certified by Chartered accountant to fulfill the criteria

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
